subject: agent://curia.example/tuesdaycrowd/scriptor
note: A log key P (kid LK) at 0; a second log.key at 1 that lists kid LK again with another key Q (it holds no position and publishes no key); a log.operator-key at 2 (kid OK, key Q), which is therefore no log key and holds a position. An attestation at 5 signed by Q under kid OK is honoured. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
